body:
> Maybe the best diagnostic trait of the leftist is his tendency to sympathize
> with the following movements: feminism, gay rights, ethnic rights, disability
>  rights, animal rights, political correctness.  Anyone who strongly sympathizes
> with ALL of these movements is almost certainly a leftist.
 
> Amazing.  The ARROGANCE that they have to believe they must re-educate people
> into thinking in the way that they do.  This could have not been expressed more
> succinctly.

By contrast, the diagnostic trait of the right winger must be his
tendency to not give a damn about the rights of anyone who is not a
straight, affluent, young, WASP, white male. Anyone who shows no
sympathy for anyone except those in his own little social/ethnic circle
is almost certainly a rightist. And these people have, up until the
60's, had the ARROGANCE to think that they were the MORALLY CORRECT
people and had the right to force everyone else to think as they did.

Think about what you are really saying. Does the above paragraph apply
to you? Or is the the anti-leftist rant merely a hollow attempt to say
something "cool and rebellious" against the "current social order"? Are
"leftists" merely a convenient scapegoat/whipping boy?
